mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic stress.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in one month, or Rank IC over 2-year window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in one month indicate broad consumer demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in one month, or Rank IC over 3-year window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply shocks (INDPRO below 100.0) during economic recovery phases correlate with negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as production disruptions depress corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0, or Rank IC over 3-year window remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly non-farm payrolls growth above 100,000 signals labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through enhanced consumer spending capacity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 100,000, or Rank IC over 3-year window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1,500,000 units in one month indicates housing sector contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days due to reduced construction-related economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 1500.0 in one month, or Rank IC over 2-year window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate declines exceeding 0.25 percentage points and CPIAUCSL declines exceeding 0.25 index points signal deflationary monetary policy response, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines > 0.25pp and CPIAUCSL declines > 0.25 points in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS declines > 0.25pp and CPIAUCSL declines > 0.25 points in one month, or Rank IC over 3-year window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer spending recovery (RSAFS above 480,000 million dollars) during post-shock periods correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as retail sales growth supports corporate revenue expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 480,000, or Rank IC over 3-year window remains below 0.02.
